surface.description: Where it would be posted: a new comment, a reply in a thread, or a review

pr.description: The pull request, as <owner>/<name>#<n>, the queue item's pr label

path.description: Path relative to the repository root, or null for a top-level comment

line.description: The line in path the comment is on, or null

in_reply_to.description: The GitHub comment or review thread it answers, or null

body.description: The text to post, exactly as the owner will see it

from.description: The link to the packet thread it was converted from, or null
